assertions.name: tools/list exposes exactly the 15 registered tools
returned plan conforms to the pinned V3 shape (after removing the two declared wrapper keys)
plan carries null compiled hashes (planning-only over MCP)
plan declares tool_execution NOT_RUN (MCP never executes)
plan_workflow is deterministic (same input -> same plan_id)
plan_workflow with provider:'deepseek' returns a real LLM-planned execution-plan/1.0
DeepSeek proposal reproduces the CLI DeepSeek journey's plan (temperature-0 determinism across entries)
provider:'deepseek' without a key fails closed with BLOCKED_PROVIDER (never mocked)
assertions.detail: {"status":"ERROR","message":"WorkflowError: provider 'deepseek' requires DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in the host environment; it is never mocked"}

assertions.name: CLI and MCP planners agree on the identical plan object (same plan_id)

tools.name: list_formal_tools
tools.description: List original 13 native adapters, 23 candidate portfolio tools, and 4 pure JS model checkers.

tools.name: validate_formal_source
tools.description: Validate Skill names and repository inputs; does NOT run proof engines.

tools.name: inspect_formal_tool
tools.description: Describe registered native tool usage and positive/negative fixture expectations.

tools.name: probe_formal_tool
tools.description: Attempt a tool --version/--help via Node process, not a theorem proof.

tools.name: run_formal_fixture
tools.description: Execute a fixed, committed tool fixture, not arbitrary shell or user code.

tools.name: describe_native_cli
tools.description: Describe a tool and its named CLI operations, without executing anything.

tools.name: inspect_native_installation
tools.description: Read-only installed executable/JAR discovery and missing dependency diagnostics. Does NOT launch native tools.

tools.name: plan_native_cli
tools.description: Validate native CLI option values, return planned argv; NO execution and NO raw passthrough.

tools.name: list_portfolio_tools
tools.description: Read-only capability and tool metadata for all 36 tools. Never implies a T3/T4/T5 PASS.

tools.name: match_formal_capabilities
tools.description: Deterministic capability-ID to validated-tool match over the r176 container probe receipts. Read-only; capability IDs come from the frozen discovery registry. Probe receipts are technical evidence, never a T3/T4/T5/T6 or business acceptance.

tools.name: inspect_portfolio_tool
tools.description: Read-only pinned portable installation metadata; no process launch.

tools.name: verify_portable_fixture
tools.description: Run ONLY the candidate tool's committed portable pos/neg/err fixture through a SHA-pinned runner. No user input/raw argv/shell. Technical evidence only, not business verification.

tools.name: run_portfolio_operation
tools.description: Run a registered typed candidate operation through the shared portfolio Runner. Currently only Highs 1.15.1 solve-lp is admitted; accepts a bounded LP model, never raw argv, shell, script path or arbitrary file input.

tools.name: verify_formal_model
tools.description: Run real finite-model checks in pure JS: DAG, writer exclusivity, CNF or finite state.

tools.name: plan_workflow
tools.description: Plan a bounded user problem into a formal-tools/execution-plan/1.0 workflow (PLANNING ONLY - never executes anything; tool_execution stays NOT_RUN). Deterministic z3+cvc5 cross-check template by default; the canonical problem text is used verbatim as the SMT-LIB input of both solvers. Optional provider:'deepseek' replaces the template with ONE real DeepSeek method proposal using DEEPSEEK_API_KEY from the host environment (absent key fails closed with BLOCKED_PROVIDER; never mocked). Execution is intentionally NOT exposed over MCP: run the compiled plan on a trusted host via the SDK/CLI.
